variables.description: The port on the host that Homepage's web interface will be accessible on.
variables.label: Homepage Web Port

variables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed hostnames/IPs. Required for security. See Homepage documentation for details. Example: 'yourdomain.com,192.168.1.100:3000'.
variables.label: Homepage Allowed Hosts

variables.description: User ID for the container. Set to 0 for root. Note: The container is configured to run as root (0:0) by default to prevent permission issues with mounted volumes, but this variable is provided for advanced customization.
variables.label: User ID (PUID)

variables.description: Group ID for the container. Set to 0 for root. Note: The container is configured to run as root (0:0) by default to prevent permission issues with mounted volumes, but this variable is provided for advanced customization.
variables.label: Group ID (PGID)
